Perennos Tempo 2.0.1 fixes the Windows installer's first run and makes Tempo Studio reachable. Everything else is as in 2.0.0.

## What changed

- **Nothing large downloads during install.** The installer's "Download models that fit this computer now" box is unticked by default and says it downloads several gigabytes. Ticked and with Ollama installed, it downloads what fits and says so while it works. Otherwise the installer only writes the plan, and the first start of Perennos Tempo shows which models fit.
- **Tempo Studio has a Start-menu entry and a command.** `tempo-launch studio` starts Tempo and opens its page, since Studio works through Tempo: ask it to analyse or master a file in your Music folder.
- **A clearer finish page.** It says "Perennos Tempo is installed", and when Ollama is not found, where to get it (https://ollama.com/download) and that the first start shows which models fit.
- **Ollama is also found in Program Files** (an all-users install).
- **Ollama comes with Tempo.** On a computer without Ollama, the installer's "Download Ollama" box is ticked: it fetches Tempo's own copy (about 1.4 GB) and checks it against a pinned SHA-256 before it runs. `tempo-launch setup --ollama` does the same later. `tempo-launch start` says plainly when Ollama is missing.
- **A welcome page on the first start.** Tempo scans the computer (memory, graphics card, disk) and says in plain words what it can run, then asks whether this is one computer or several (a home server, a laptop, a GPU box). Several computers: run `tempo-launch setup --apply` on each one, then `tempo-launch link <address>` on the one you sit at (private and tailnet addresses only).
- **Let your own AI help you set up.** The welcome page gives copy-paste entries for Claude Desktop, Claude Code and other MCP clients for `tempo-launch mcp`. Your AI can see the scan facts and the recommended plan, never your files, notes or chats, and it can only propose a settings change: you apply it with `tempo-launch setup --apply-proposal`, after seeing exactly what changes. Nothing connects unless you add the entry to your AI.
- **The agent says at once when Ollama isn't answering**, instead of retrying for a minute, and its background commands end with it on every system.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `PerennosTempo-Setup-2.0.1-x64-source-available.exe` | Windows 10 and 11 (x64) |
| `perennos-tempo-source-available-2.0.1-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` | macOS on Apple silicon |
| `perennos-tempo-source-available-2.0.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` | Linux (x86_64) |
| `perennos-tempo-source-available_2.0.1-1_amd64.deb` | Debian and Ubuntu (x86_64) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | The SHA-256 of every file above |

Check a download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo Perennos/perennos-tempo`. On Windows, the installer is not code-signed: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
